text_block_list.text:
Марузенски wins the race with a
performance that
impresses even
Симболи Рудольф, and then sets her
sights
on the Yasuda Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф vows to have a rematch
with
Марузенски and declares her
intention to surpass
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Марузенски's racing, which has

fascinated many, has an altogether
different
effect on certain others...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик and Грасс Вандер begin
to feel
that catching up to Марузенски is
a dream too far
out of reach.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
